name: expenses
label: Expenses
description: An employee files what they paid for the company, their manager approves it, and finance pays it back.
next: make the people, put somebody in hr and somebody in finance, and let hr write each person's manager into Employees

definition.name: Expenses
definition.label: Expenses
definition.description: What employees paid for the company: approved by their manager, paid back by finance.

object.name: hr
object.label: HR
object.description: Keeps who works here and who each person's manager is, in the table Employees.

object.name: finance
object.label: Finance
object.description: Reads every expense, and pays back the approved ones.

definition.name: Employees
definition.label: Employees
definition.description: Who each person's manager is. A person is a user of the database, by their id; their name is the user's own.

person.label: Person
person.description: The id of the user who works here.

manager.label: Manager
manager.description: The id of the user who decides their expenses.

definition.name: Expense
definition.label: Expense
definition.description: What an employee paid for the company and asks to be paid back. The employee's manager decides it; finance pays it.
definition.title: what

what.label: What
what.description: A few words a colleague would understand.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: What the employee is paid back.

employee.label: Employee
employee.description: Who paid: the user who filed the expense, or the one an assistant filed it for.

manager.label: Manager
manager.description: Who decides: the employee's manager in Employees at the moment the expense is submitted.

decided_by.label: Decided by
decided_by.description: Who approved or rejected the expense.

descriptions.draft: Being filled in; only the employee sees it.
descriptions.rejected: The manager turned it down; it is kept.

transitions.name: submit
transitions.label: Submit
transitions.description: The employee sends the expense to their manager, who must be in Employees.
transitions.guard: amount > 0 AND NOT ISBLANK(LOOKUP(Employees, manager, person = THIS.employee))

transitions.name: approve
transitions.label: Approve
transitions.description: The manager accepts the expense for payment.

transitions.name: reject
transitions.label: Reject
transitions.description: The manager turns the expense down.

transitions.name: pay
transitions.label: Pay back
transitions.description: Finance has paid the employee back.

access.read: employee = USER() OR employee = ACTINGFOR() OR (NOT ISBLANK(manager) AND (manager = USER() OR manager = ACTINGFOR())) OR INGROUP("finance")
access.update: (employee = USER() OR employee = ACTINGFOR()) AND STATE() = "draft"
access.delete: (employee = USER() OR employee = ACTINGFOR()) AND STATE() = "draft"

transition.approve: (manager = USER() OR manager = ACTINGFOR()) AND employee <> USER() AND employee <> ACTINGFOR()
